CD8+ T cells: CD8+ cytotoxic T lymphocytes. Tumor-infiltrating CD8+ T cells expressing cytotoxic effector molecules.
Macrophages: Tumor-associated macrophages. Myeloid macrophage populations in the cancer microenvironment.
Epithelial cells: Malignant epithelial cells. Cancer cells of epithelial origin with tumor-associated expression programs.
NK cells: Natural killer cells. Innate lymphoid NK cells with cytotoxic activity in the tumor microenvironment.
